notes.title: Final August Update (0.4)
notes.content:
here are some changes that were made during august~
- a tutorial at the start of the game for proper guidance has been added~
- you can step on bugs (and other stuff...) now while controlling any doll~
- template/example/preset diorama's (speaking of, there will now be a monthly building contest held on our discord server, winners will end up having their diorama added as a template...)
- doors are now enterable when interacting with them, making already infinite diorama's even more infinite~
- a few ui adjustments such as more control hints, bolder font and others~
- improvements to multiplayer~
- speaking of, there's a multiplayer chat now! (with bbcode [rainbow] support!!!)~
- the MOON~ :cheese: 
- eggs~
- experimental custom furniture support (to add custom sprites, simply drag them into the game window! please join our discord for more assistance for now and to find furniture others have created...)~
- you can drag .tres (mod files!) into the game as well to make it easier to add mods, same for save files (.diorama)~
- experimental undo/redo~
- around 20-ish new ambient (including music) tracks? i didn't really count but there are weird bird noises now~
- more achievements (=^ ◡ ^=)
- around 100 new decorations including furniture, dolls, plushies and carpets~
- ambience and other sounds will now be drowned out in menus~
- improved powerpole connections~
- a toggle to enable clouds/fog~
- a slider in the settings to adjust the camera speed with~
- the camera now strolls around your diorama when idling for a while (convenient for screensavers and such, it can also be toggled off in the settings...)
- dedicated meow button~ (M)
- balloons will now be released when interacting with them~
- there has been an unused vase i forgot to add and it's been bothering me ever since, anyways i added it now~
- less rain (it messed up the bitrate of streams)
- ability to rename dioramas~
- added mouse drag gestures for anything that's able to scroll~

0.5 will primarily focus on adding more furniture again, happy decorating ♡
